Name: NPC Info
Author: EurekaDotNet
Description:
[size=5][b]NPCInfo Mod for Stardew Valley
[/b][/size]
[b]Overview:[/b]
This mod adds essential information about NPCs directly to your gameplay, making it easier to interact with your favorite characters. If you find it challenging to keep track of all the nuances of each NPC, this mod takes the burden off your shoulders, allowing you to focus on enjoying the game without the hassle of remembering every detail.

[b]Features:[/b]
- [b]NPC Name Display:[/b] View the name of each NPC at the top of their dialogue box for quick identification.
- [b]Gift/Speak Icons:[/b] 
  - An icon will indicate when you should give a gift to the NPC.
  - An icon will prompt you to speak to the NPC.
  - A special icon will mark the NPC's birthday.
- [b]Last Gift Tracking:[/b] Keep track of the last gift you gave each NPC, with color coding to indicate if it was:
  - [color=green]Loved[/color]
  - [color=#0000ff]Liked
[/color]  - [color=#cccccc]Neutral
[/color]  - [color=#ff7700]Disliked[/color]
  - [color=#ff0000]Hated[/color]
[color=#efefef][i]    Note: Only gifts given since the mod is installed will be displayed. Gifts given prior to installation cannot be tracked.[/i][/color]
- [b]Configurable: [/b]Configure what you want to display using Generic Mod Config Menu

[b]Installation:[/b]
1. Ensure you have [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] installed.
2. Download the NPCInfo mod from the [url=link_to_your_mod]releases page[/url].
3. Extract the contents of the zip file into your [i]Mods[/i] folder in your Stardew Valley installation directory.
4. Launch the game through SMAPI.

[b]Compatibility:[/b]
- This mod is compatible with Stardew Valley version 1.6 and higher. 
- Make sure you have the latest version of SMAPI for the best experience.

[b]Source Code:[/b]
The source code for NPCInfo is available on [url=https://github.com/Eureka-dot-net/NPCInfo]GitHub[/url]. Feel free to explore, contribute, or report any issues.

[b]Feedback and Support:[/b]
Feel free to leave comments or suggestions in the discussion section. If you encounter any issues, please open a support ticket.

[b]Enjoy less stressful interaction with your favorite NPCs![/b]
